Preparing for New Roof Installation Allentown 7 Expert Tips for Success

7 April 2025 Roof Installation

Planning a roof upgrade? That’s a big and exciting step—especially here in Allentown, where our roofs face everything from harsh winters to summer storms. If you’re preparing for new roof installation, knowing what to expect and how to get ready can make the entire process smooth and stress-free.

Here are seven expert-backed tips to help you prepare your home, your schedule, and your mindset for a successful roofing project in Allentown.

Tip One Know what to expect during the installation

First things first—roof installation is a noisy, dusty, and busy process. Roofing crews will be removing your old roof, laying down new materials, and possibly making repairs to the underlying structure. Expect hammering, foot traffic, and some temporary mess in your yard and attic.

Good roofing companies like ours will walk you through what the project includes, how long it will take, and what areas of your home may be affected. In Allentown, most full roof replacements take between one to three days, depending on weather and roof size.

Tip Two Clear your driveway and outdoor spaces

Roofing materials need to be delivered and stored somewhere close to your home, and your contractor will also need room for a dumpster or trailer to collect debris. Make things easier by clearing your driveway, moving cars to the street, and relocating patio furniture or potted plants that sit close to the house.

This step not only protects your belongings but also gives your roofers the space they need to work efficiently and safely.

Tip Three Protect your attic and valuables

Dust and small debris can fall into your attic during installation, especially during the tear-off phase. If you use your attic for storage, cover your items with old sheets, tarps, or plastic sheeting.

For extra peace of mind, remove fragile items from walls on upper floors, especially anything hanging directly below the roofline. Vibration from the work can knock things loose.

Tip Four Let your neighbors know ahead of time

Out of courtesy, give your neighbors a heads-up. Roof work can be noisy, and knowing in advance allows them to prepare too—especially if they have pets, work from home, or young kids.

A quick message or chat goes a long way and helps maintain good relationships in your Allentown neighborhood.

Tip Five Make arrangements for pets and small children

Dogs and kids may not enjoy the loud noises or strangers walking around outside your windows. If possible, plan playdates, visits to the park, or even a short getaway during the most active days of the installation.

Not only does this reduce stress for your little ones, but it also helps your roofing crew work without distractions or concerns about safety.

Tip Six Talk to your roofing contractor about weather plans

Allentown’s weather can change fast, so make sure your roofing company has a plan in place. At In The Light Roofing, we closely monitor forecasts and schedule jobs during dry windows. If unexpected rain rolls in, we protect exposed areas with tarps and pause the project until it’s safe to continue.

Good communication ensures your home stays protected no matter what the weather brings.

Tip Seven Work with a local contractor who knows Allentown homes

Older homes in Allentown neighborhoods like West End, Old Allentown, and South Mountain come with unique challenges—steeper pitches, historic materials, and varying layers of old roofing. That’s why it pays to work with a local expert who understands what Allentown roofs need.

Our New Roof Installation service includes free inspections, detailed prep advice, and complete cleanup—so you’re never left guessing.

Final thoughts on preparing for new roof installation Allentown 7 expert tips for success

Preparing for new roof installation doesn’t have to be overwhelming. With a little planning, the right local contractor, and a clear understanding of what’s ahead, you’ll be set up for success. Your new roof is a major investment—but it also means years of comfort, protection, and peace of mind.

At In The Light Roofing, we’re proud to serve Allentown homeowners with expert guidance, clean work, and honest pricing. Whether you’re in the early planning stages or ready to get started this month, we’re here to make your roofing project as smooth and successful as possible.
